response.sql: WITH scan_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin as gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0), operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, AVG(gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM scan_metrics GROUP BY crewref), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) as global_avg_gb_per_min FROM scan_metrics), above_average_operators AS (SELECT os.avg_gb_per_min, os.scan_count, os.avg_gb_per_min - ga.global_avg_gb_per_min as excess FROM operator_stats os CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > ga.global_avg_gb_per_min) SELECT AVG(scan_count) as avg_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_average_operators
